
```{r}
#| label: data-r-libs
#| output: false
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(yaml)
```

```{r}
#| label: data-config
#| output: false
config <- read_yaml("../config/config.yaml")
```

```{r}
#| label: data-params
#| output: false
#| include: false

cutoff <- as.Date(config$report$cutoff_lower)
cutoff_display <- format(cutoff, "%d %b %Y")
ojs_define(cutoff = config$report$cutoff_lower, cutoffDisplay = cutoff_display)
```

```{r}
#| label: data-clusters
#| output: false
#| include: false

linelist <- read_csv("../results/dashboard_data/linelist.csv") %>%
  rename(subtype = subtype_prrtin) # patch

seq_linelist <- linelist %>%
  filter(linked & cluster_analysis) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  mutate(cluster_size = case_when(
    is.na(cluster_id) ~ "Singleton", # ID not assigned in hivtrace steps for singletons
    n() == 2 ~ "Pair",
    n() >= 3 & n() < 10 ~ "Small",
    TRUE ~ "Large"
  )) %>%
  mutate(cluster_active = ifelse(
    any(date_onset >= cutoff), TRUE, FALSE
  )) %>%
  ungroup()


# Only clusters
cluster_linelist <- seq_linelist %>%
  filter(cluster_size %in% c("Small", "Large"))

ojs_define(linelist = seq_linelist, clusterLinelist = cluster_linelist) # will need renaming
```

```{r}
#| label: sequences
#| output: false

sequences <- ape::read.dna(
  "../results/dashboard_data/sequences.fasta",
  format = "fasta"
)

sequence_bases <- as.character(sequences)

coverage_df <- tibble(
  position = seq_len(ncol(sequence_bases)),
  coverage = apply(
    sequence_bases,
    2,
    \(site) mean(site %in% c("a", "c", "g", "t"))
  )
)

```
